{{Top|leg}}
The '''devourer organism''' was a type of creature used for garbage disposal. Created by the government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the last of the forest regions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were built upon, it was a red, liquid 'goo' consisting of many monocellular life-forms. It's purpose was to consume anything [[Species/Legends|organic]] that was thrown into it, however, it could also consume some inorganic materials as well, such as [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]].<ref name="EN II RS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the rest of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and [[Wraith Squadron]] strike team encountered one such organism on Coruscant during [[Mission to Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|their mission]]. It was in a [[Devourer tank|tank]], at the bottom of which it concealed a wheel that activated a hidden [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].<ref name="EN II RS" />
